{"type":"message","message":{"id":"AihuarzUD4PUjMcPmtPn4A4","role":"assistant","created":1785604100,"content":[{"type":"toolRequest","id":"f8eRjNEq__thought__","toolCall":{"status":"success","value":{"name":"shell","arguments":{"command":"python3 -c \"\nimport glob, re, os\n\nseverities = set()\nnon_matching = []\n\npattern = re.compile(r'\\[(ERROR|WARNING|INFO|DEBUG|CRITICAL|FATAL|TRACE)\\]')\n\nfor file in glob.glob('/app/logs/*.log'):\n    with open(file, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore') as f:\n        for line_num, line in enumerate(f, 1):\n            m = re.search(r'\\[([A-Z]+)\\]', line)\n            if m:\n                severities.add(m.group(1))\n            else:\n                non_matching.append((file, line_num, line.strip()))\n\nprint('Found bracketed severities:', severities)\nprint('Non-matching lines count:', len(non_matching))\nif non_matching:\n    print('Sample non-matching lines:', non_matching[:10])\n\""}}},"metadata":{"provider_specific_fields":{"thought_signature":""}},"_meta":{"goose_extension":"developer"}}],"metadata":{"userVisible":true,"agentVisible":true}}}

{"type":"message","message":{"id":"GihuatKLBMOW_uMPkqGd-Ao","role":"assistant","created":1785604128,"content":[{"type":"toolRequest","id":"JEjP24BW__thought__","toolCall":{"status":"success","value":{"name":"shell","arguments":{"command":"python3 -c \"\nimport glob, os, re, csv, datetime\n\nREF_DATE = datetime.date(2025, 8, 12)\n\n# Periods definition\nPERIODS = ['today', 'last_7_days', 'last_30_days', 'month_to_date', 'total']\nSEVERITIES = ['ERROR', 'WARNING', 'INFO']\n\ncounts = {p: {s: 0 for s in SEVERITIES} for p in PERIODS}\n\nline_regex = re.compile(r'^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2} \\d{2}:\\d{2}:\\d{2} \\[(ERROR|WARNING|INFO|DEBUG)\\]')\n\nfor filepath in glob.glob('/app/logs/*.log'):\n    filename = os.path.basename(filepath)\n    date_str = filename.split('_')[0]\n    file_date = datetime.datetime.strptime(date_str, '%Y-%m-%d').date()\n\n    with open(filepath, 'r') as f:\n        for line in f:\n            m = line_regex.match(line)\n            if not m:\n                continue\n            sev = m.group(1)\n            if sev not in SEVERITIES:\n                continue\n\n            # Check period memberships\n            # total\n            counts['total'][sev] += 1\n\n            # today\n            if file_date == REF_DATE:\n                counts['today'][sev] += 1\n\n            # last_7_days (7 days including today: delta 0..6)\n            delta_days = (REF_DATE - file_date).days\n            if 0 <= delta_days < 7:\n                counts['last_7_days'][sev] += 1\n\n            # last_30_days (30 days including today: delta 0..29)\n            if 0 <= delta_days < 30:\n                counts['last_30_days'][sev] += 1\n\n            # month_to_date (from 1st of current month up to today)\n            if file_date.year == REF_DATE.year and file_date.month == REF_DATE.month and file_date <= REF_DATE:\n                counts['month_to_date'][sev] += 1\n\nfor p in PERIODS:\n    for s in SEVERITIES:\n        print(f'{p},{s},{counts[p][s]}')\n\""}}},"metadata":{"provider_specific_fields":{"thought_signature":""}},"_meta":{"goose_extension":"developer"}}],"metadata":{"userVisible":true,"agentVisible":true}}}

{"type":"message","message":{"id":"LyhuaoPIGpSfjMcPtun-yAE","role":"assistant","created":1785604151,"content":[{"type":"toolRequest","id":"xzlu4bNs__thought__","toolCall":{"status":"success","value":{"name":"write","arguments":{"content":"import csv\nimport datetime\nimport glob\nimport os\nimport re\n\nLOG_DIR = \"/app/logs\"\nOUTPUT_FILE = \"/app/summary.csv\"\nREF_DATE = datetime.date(2025, 8, 12)\n\nPERIODS = [\"today\", \"last_7_days\", \"last_30_days\", \"month_to_date\", \"total\"]\nSEVERITIES = [\"ERROR\", \"WARNING\", \"INFO\"]\n\ncounts = {p: {s: 0 for s in SEVERITIES} for p in PERIODS}\n\nline_regex = re.compile(\n    r\"^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2} \\d{2}:\\d{2}:\\d{2} \\[(ERROR|WARNING|INFO|DEBUG)\\]\"\n)\n\nfor filepath in glob.glob(os.path.join(LOG_DIR, \"*.log\")):\n    filename = os.path.basename(filepath)\n    date_str = filename.split(\"_\")[0]\n    file_date = datetime.datetime.strptime(date_str, \"%Y-%m-%d\").date()\n\n    with open(filepath, \"r\", encoding=\"utf-8\", errors=\"ignore\") as f:\n        for line in f:\n            m = line_regex.match(line)\n            if not m:\n                continue\n            sev = m.group(1)\n            if sev not in SEVERITIES:\n                continue\n\n            # Total\n            counts[\"total\"][sev] += 1\n\n            # Today\n            if file_date == REF_DATE:\n                counts[\"today\"][sev] += 1\n\n            # Last 7 days (including today)\n            delta_days = (REF_DATE - file_date).days\n            if 0 <= delta_days < 7:\n                counts[\"last_7_days\"][sev] += 1\n\n            # Last 30 days (including today)\n            if 0 <= delta_days < 30:\n                counts[\"last_30_days\"][sev] += 1\n\n            # Month to date\n            if (\n                file_date.year == REF_DATE.year\n                and file_date.month == REF_DATE.month\n                and file_date <= REF_DATE\n            ):\n                counts[\"month_to_date\"][sev] += 1\n\nwith open(OUTPUT_FILE, \"w\", newline=\"\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n    writer = csv.writer(f)\n    writer.writerow([\"period\", \"severity\", \"count\"])\n    for p in PERIODS:\n        for s in SEVERITIES:\n            writer.writerow([p, s, counts[p][s]])\n\nprint(f\"Generated {OUTPUT_FILE} successfully.\")\n","path":"/app/generate_summary.py"}}},"metadata":{"provider_specific_fields":{"thought_signature":""}},"_meta":{"goose_extension":"developer"}}],"metadata":{"userVisible":true,"agentVisible":true}}}
